question.instructions: `{ref}` describes one piece of software work (a requirement, task or issue, possibly with technical details). How much development work does it take to complete?
levels: Trivial: a typo, a config value or a one-line fix; well under an hour
Small: a contained change in one place; a few hours
Medium: a feature or fix touching several parts; about one or two days
Large: a substantial feature or refactoring across components; several days to a week
Very large: a new subsystem, a major redesign or many unknowns; more than a week

input: title + first 1500 characters of the description
selection: lowest mean VALIDATION MAE over the 16 projects; then one run on TEST
published_comparison: Table 3 of the authors' preprint: Deep-SE, Mean, Median test MAE
primary_metric: test MAE per project vs Deep-SE (published) and vs Mean/Median computed on the same split
